description.zh: 从视觉方向、字体到布局组织界面设计与自审；对应 Apache-2.0，工程正确性需另行检查。
description.en: Visual direction, typography, layout and self-review. Corresponding Apache-2.0 license; engineering correctness needs separate checks.

readmeDescription.zh: 从视觉方向、字体到布局组织界面设计，并要求自审。适合能制作界面的 Agent；侧重视觉表达，工程正确性需另行检查。[对应许可：Apache-2.0]({{@frontend-design.licenseUrl}})。
readmeDescription.en: Organizes interface design around visual direction, typography, layout and self-review. Intended for agents that can build interfaces; it focuses on visual expression, while engineering correctness needs separate checks. [Corresponding license: Apache-2.0]({{@frontend-design.licenseUrl}}).

description.zh: 材料收集、协作起草与读者检查的多轮文档流程；需宿主工具适配，所选目录的转载许可未核实，仅链接介绍。
description.en: A multi-turn document workflow: gather context, draft together and check with readers. Adapt host tools; copying permission for this directory is unverified. Source link only.

readmeDescription.zh: 将材料收集、协作起草和读者检查连成多轮文档流程，补充单次改写模板。需要持续交互并匹配宿主工具名称；所选目录的复制许可未核实，仅作链接介绍。
readmeDescription.en: Connects context gathering, collaborative drafting and reader checks in a multi-turn document workflow, complementing one-pass rewriting templates. Requires ongoing interaction and matching host tool names. Copying permission for the selected directory is unverified; this is a source-link introduction.

description.zh: 简短通用互动规则，每轮不代替用户决定行动；需替换 user/char 宏，根许可 AGPL-3.0，复制衍生兼容性未评估。
description.en: Concise interaction rules that preserve user agency. Requires user/char macro substitution. Root AGPL-3.0; derivative compatibility unassessed.

readmeDescription.zh: 用简短通用规则组织角色与环境描写，每次回复一轮，不代替用户决定行动。需宿主替换 `{{user}}`、`{{char}}`；[仓库根许可为 AGPL-3.0]({{@immersive.licenseUrl}})，复制衍生的许可兼容性未评估。
readmeDescription.en: Uses short general rules for character and environment descriptions, producing one reply without deciding the user's actions. The host must substitute `{{user}}` and `{{char}}`. The [repository root license is AGPL-3.0]({{@immersive.licenseUrl}}); compatibility for copied or derivative material has not been assessed.

description.zh: 维护者自有项目：需求澄清、任务跟踪、暂停续接、跨会话交接与清晰表达。按原项目按需安装。
description.en: Maintainer-owned workflows for clarification, tracking, pausing, handoff and communication. Install selected skills using the original project instructions.

readmeDescription.zh: 围绕需求澄清、任务跟踪、暂停续接与跨会话交接组织工作；另含清晰表达和学术文字编辑技能。完整清单与安装说明见原项目，本地固定版本入口为 `Skills/compass-skills/`。
readmeDescription.en: Workflows for clarification, task tracking, pausing/resuming and cross-session handoff, plus clear communication and academic editing. See the original project for the full list and installation. The locally pinned entry is `Skills/compass-skills/`.

description.zh: 按模型家族整理系统提示词、角色设定与工作区指令；本次核对项目说明和目录，未逐项审阅或测试效果，仅链接介绍。
description.en: System prompts, personas and workspace instructions by model family. Review covered the description and directory, not every prompt or effectiveness. Source links only.

readmeDescription.zh: 按模型家族整理系统提示词、角色设定与工作区指令，便于对照不同指令形式。[核对版本]({{@jailbreak-research.versionUrl}})（2026-10-30）；本次核对项目说明与目录，未逐项审阅或测试效果，仅作外链介绍。
readmeDescription.en: Organizes system prompts, persona definitions and workspace instructions by model family for comparing instruction formats. [Version checked]({{@jailbreak-research.versionUrl}}) on 2026-10-30; review covered the project description and directory, without reviewing every prompt or testing effectiveness. This is a source-link introduction.
